findings.description: After a flat-ground tail pop at ~00:01.25 (board leaves ground ~00:01.4), rider and board stay airborne until ~00:03.3, roughly 1.9 s. A flat-ground ollie/flip lasts ~0.4-0.6 s; between ~00:01.9 and 00:02.75 rider and board hover at near-constant height while the board slowly rotates, with no deceleration/descent consistent with the pop. Effect (hang time) far outlasts its cause.

Second pop at ~00:07.75-00:08.0 leads to an airborne phase lasting until ~00:09.4 (~1.4-1.5 s), with board and rider floating at roughly constant height 00:08.25-00:08.75 before slowly descending. The airtime greatly exceeds what a flat-ground pop could produce.
